::: {#exr-panda-run-magnet}
Write down an algorithm for adding two numbers, each with 2 digits. You can assume that you already have the algorithm for adding single digits, for instance 7 + 2.

In addition to your algorithm, write down a table that shows the output for adding any digit 0 to 9 to another digit.
